audit: Phase 33 Neural Production Execution & Latency Gap Audit

latency_gap_resolution.root_cause: Different architectural execution scopes: live serving executes the fast deterministic pipeline (G1 + TF-IDF + G2 MSD + Firewall + Generator) in 2.5ms, while DeBERTa NLI forward pass executes CPU sequence classification in 65ms.
latency_gap_resolution.telemetry_truthfulness: VERIFIED_TRUTHFUL. Service explicitly surfaces inference_mode='deterministic_cpu' when DeBERTa is not invoked, and never fabricates neural inference.
latency_gap_resolution.conflation_risk: High if consumers assume live serving includes per-claim DeBERTa NLI verification by default.
